name: Bamboo Blade ~Fukushuu no Houkago~
original_name: バンブーブレイド～復讐の放課後～
source:
This is a novel adventure game based on the series, "Bamboo Blade."

The main character decides to revenge against Kendo Club who took Tamaki away.
His vengeful thoughts turn into desire and starts violating other female members of the club.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044694.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款根据《竹刃》系列改编的小说冒险游戏。

主角决定向夺走环的剑道部报仇。
他的复仇想法变成了欲望，并开始侵犯俱乐部的其他女性成员。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044694.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
